note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(走进自然主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: When Tom joined a group that records wild birds, he could not even tell one bird from another. Instead of giving up, he went out every weekend and slowly learned to know each one by its call. A year later, he could name almost any bird in the park, and he was proud that his patience had turned a hard hobby into a real joy.

questions.q: What did Tom do instead of giving up?
options: He kept going out each weekend and learned the birds by their calls.
He stopped joining the group at once.
He bought every bird he saw.
He asked others to do the work for him.
questions.explanation: 原文 'went out every weekend and slowly learned to know each one by its call' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How did Tom feel a year later?
options: Pleased that his steady effort had been worth it.
Sorry that he had ever started.
Worried that he still knew nothing.
questions.explanation: 末句 'was proud that his patience had turned a hard hobby into a real joy'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
